A higher percentage of White children (4.5%) had received COVID-19 vaccination

methods_quotes.q: Weighted proportions with 95% CIs were estimated, accounting for the complex survey design and weights
T-tests for proportions were used to test for differences, with p-values <0.05 considered statistically significant.
